messages.subject: Parallel execution
parts: I wish you good work. My blavaan process is taking too long. It will take about 3 months. I wonder if I can use parallel processing to speed up this process. Is there any way to split the process into cores and run it faster?

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: Parallel execution
parts:
İbrahim,

You could send each chain to a different core by adding this to your
bsem/bcfa/blavaan command:

bcontrol = list(cores = 3)

where the "3" could change if you are running more/fewer than 3 chains.

If you have a big dataset or big model, you might run the model on a
subset of the data or on smaller pieces of the model to ensure that
things are working correctly. Sometimes the model is slow because it is
not working correctly.

Ed
